requirements.text: Preserve the existing host ports and widths listed in the baseline contract. Accept a request only on a rising clk edge with txn_valid && txn_ready. Hold payload while stalled. Consecutive accepted cycles with txn_valid held high are distinct requests. cmd_ready is execution/timing visibility, not the host acceptance handshake. Deassert txn_ready and rsp_valid during reset.
requirements.verification: Drive txn_valid high for consecutive ready cycles and verify distinct queue entries; stall with txn_ready low and verify no admission; assert reset and verify txn_ready and rsp_valid are low.

requirements.text: Preserve the simplified 4-bit txn_addr mapping: row=txn_addr[3:2], column=txn_addr[1:0], zero-extended into the internal 10-bit row and 6-bit column fields. Preserve explicit txn_bank for multi-bank configurations; a single-bank configuration uses bank 0. Internal packed requests retain bank(2), row(10), column(6), write flag(1), write data(32).
requirements.verification: Submit all sixteen txn_addr values in two banks and inspect packed fields and independent memory locations.

requirements.text: Provide functional 32-bit memory storage with 16 addresses per bank, bank isolation and reset-to-zero contents. Accepted writes update only their addressed location at service completion or a committed WRITE. Each accepted read produces exactly one one-cycle rsp_valid pulse with the stored rsp_rdata after read service/READ commit, using the existing one-cycle response stage. Writes produce no host response. Selection and stalled candidates cannot mutate memory; mere command output without storage and read responses is insufficient.
requirements.verification: Write distinct values to equal addresses in separate banks, read both back, verify one delayed response pulse per read, no response for writes, and reset-to-zero behavior.

requirements.text: Use top-level clk and active-low rst_n. Reset clears pending requests, active service, row validity, memory and responses. Preserve reusable blocks with either synchronous or asynchronous active-low resets driven by the same rst_n; differing assertion styles do not require rebuilding otherwise reusable blocks. Do not change polarity without an explicit adapter.
requirements.verification: Assert rst_n low and verify queue valids, active service, row valids, timing counters, memory words, refresh state, and response stage clear.

requirements.text: Preserve four WAITING request slots PLUS one separately stored active-service request: total capacity is five outstanding requests. The active request must not consume one of the four waiting slots. Dispatch transfers a queued request into active registers and frees its waiting slot without retiring the transaction. Full queues backpressure the host; a same-cycle transfer/retirement may reuse a slot. Accepted request fields survive stalls and each accepted request is serviced exactly once. Keep admission, dispatch/retirement, service completion and read response delivery distinct.
requirements.verification: Fill four waiting slots, dispatch one into active service, refill the freed slot, and verify five outstanding requests with exactly one eventual completion per accepted request.

requirements.text: Dispatch captures the complete selected request in separate active-service registers before freeing its waiting queue slot. Hold that active request and payload across setup PRE/ACT and timing stalls until its final READ/WRITE commits. Setup commands never retire the active request. Aggregate service also keeps active-service ownership through completion. Waiting-queue dequeue at dispatch is distinct from active-request retirement. Row state changes only on the responsible committed operation; uncommitted proposals cannot change state.
requirements.verification: Dispatch a row-miss request, hold timing permission low through PRE and ACT candidates, and verify active payload remains unchanged until committed READ or WRITE.
